repos.summary_es: Modelo de programación unificado para procesamiento de datos por lotes y en tiempo real (batch y streaming).
use_cases: Definir pipelines de procesamiento de datos paralelos tanto por lotes como en streaming
Ejecutar programas en múltiples backends de procesamiento distribuido mediante PipelineRunners
evidence: Apache Beam is a unified model for defining both batch and streaming data-parallel processing pipelines, as well as a set of language-specific SDKs for constructing pipelines and Runners for executing them on distributed processing backends, including Apache Flink, Apache Spark, Google Cloud Dataflow, and Hazelcast Jet.
Beam supports executing programs on multiple distributed processing backends through PipelineRunners.

repos.summary_es: Herramienta de búsqueda orientada a líneas que busca de forma recursiva en directorios un patrón de expresión regular respetando gitignore.

Filtrar automáticamente archivos ocultos y binarios ignorando reglas de gitignore
Limitar las búsquedas a tipos específicos de archivos
evidence: ripgrep recursively searches directories for a regex pattern while respecting your gitignore
By default, ripgrep will respect gitignore rules and automatically skip hidden files/directories and binary files.
ripgrep can search specific types of files.

repos.summary_es: Solución de redes, observabilidad y seguridad basada en eBPF para contenedores y Kubernetes.

Implementar balanceo de carga distribuido
Conectar de forma segura múltiples clústeres
Aplicar políticas de red basadas en identidad
evidence: Cilium as a CNI plugin provides a fast, scalable, and secure networking layer for Kubernetes clusters.
Cilium implements distributed load balancing for traffic between pods and to external services, and is able to fully replace kube-proxy
Cluster Mesh enables secure, seamless connectivity across multiple Kubernetes clusters.
It is L7-protocol aware and can enforce network policies on L3-L7 using an identity-based security model that is decoupled from network addressing.

repos.summary_es: Sistema de base de datos analítica de alto rendimiento diseñado para ejecutarse dentro de la aplicación sin un servidor separado.

evidence: DuckDB reads and writes a wide range of file formats, including CSV, Parquet, JSON, and Excel, directly from local disk or from remote endpoints such as S3, HTTP(S), Azure, and Google Cloud Storage.
DuckDB can attach to other database systems and query them in place, so you can read, join, and move data across engines without a separate ETL step.

repos.summary_es: Herramienta para acceder de forma segura a secretos, como claves API, contraseñas y certificados, con control de acceso y registro de auditoría.
use_cases: Almacenar claves y valores arbitrarios cifrados en almacenamiento persistente
Generar secretos dinámicos bajo demanda para sistemas como AWS o bases de datos SQL
Cifrar y descifrar datos sin necesidad de almacenarlos
Revocar automáticamente secretos individuales o árboles de secretos
evidence: Vault can store arbitrary key/value pairs. Vault encrypts data before writing it to persistent storage, so gaining access to the raw storage isn't enough to access your secrets.
Vault can generate secrets on-demand for some systems, such as AWS or SQL databases.
Vault can encrypt and decrypt data without storing it.

Vault has built-in support for secret revocation. Vault can revoke not only single secrets, but a tree of secrets, for example, all secrets read by a specific user, or all secrets of a particular type.

evidence: Caching: Supports multiple eviction policies, key expiration, and hash-field expiration.
Distributed Session Store: Offers flexible session data modeling (string, JSON, hash).
